# George Wall — indie iPhone games

> Solo-developer site for two free iPhone games: GemGame (a cozy match 3 puzzle) and Fleet Commander (a single-player space strategy game). Both are free to download with optional, no-pressure in-app purchases and no ads.

This site (georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site) is built and run by George Wall, a solo indie iOS developer. It hosts the marketing, FAQ, support, and policy pages for each game. GemGame has the most extensive content, including a multilingual guide, tips, glossary, and FAQ. A detailed GemGame-specific index lives at https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/gemgame/llms.txt.

## GemGame: Match 3 Puzzle
- [GemGame home](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/gemgame/): Cozy, handcrafted match 3 puzzle for iPhone — chain striped, wrapped, and rainbow cascade combos and restore a starlit garden. Free to download, no ads, no pay-to-win. Lives refill over time for free.
- [GemGame AI index](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/gemgame/llms.txt): Detailed machine-readable index of the GemGame section
- [GemGame FAQ](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/gemgame/faq/): Is it free? Does it have ads? Can I play offline? How do lives work? Game Center?
- [GemGame guide](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/gemgame/guide/): How to play match 3 and how special gems work
- [GemGame press kit](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/gemgame/press/): Fact sheet and short/medium/long descriptions for media and creators
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761720994): GemGame — free download for iPhone

## Fleet Commander
- [Fleet Commander home](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/): Free single-player space strategy game for iPhone — colonise star systems, build task forces, and research upgrades. Optional Research Lab plans speed research by 25% while active; no ads, and paid plans do not alter combat power or matchmaking.

## Policies and support
- [Privacy](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/privacy/): Local save data and Apple in-app purchase handling
- [Support](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/support/): Restore purchases and report issues
- [Terms](https://georgepwall1991.github.io/fleet-commander-site/terms/): Terms of use
